conclusion: Registered before root GPU3 launch. Source qualification and independent review passed; no actual optimizer update or predictive result is claimed.
hypothesis: Signed differences of two observed-role tree/alignment compositions improve local ancestry accuracy and NLL over the matched parallel path-sum control and frozen smoothing baseline.
method: Two matched whole-tree arms use signed_difference=0.5*(A_new*T-T*A_old) or path_sum=0.5*(A_new*T+T*A_old). Both retain the same H030 static encoder/decoder, frozen H025 skip, genuine complete observed trees, shared learned geometry mean and unique observed-role sparse maps. Actual sample identity or unique exact descendant bitset plus observed age defines correspondence, not true ancestor identity. Ambiguous or absent roles reset to zero. No retained recurrence or tile-boundary carry.
novelty_assessment: Tree message passing, sparse role alignment, mixed path sums/differences and commutators are established. This tests predictive utility. No novel primitive, scientific priority, posterior or causal ancestry attribution is claimed. Useful signed-path evidence requires gains over matched path_sum and frozen baseline on both development parents, with class, boundary and short-tract diagnostics.
repeat_policy: New matched observed-role parallel compositions differ from H030 retained carrier memory and H032 static Gram gates. Reuse frozen H025/H026 without refitting. Only the signed_difference and path_sum arms, one seed and fixed 160 updates per arm. No added arm, accuracy checkpoint reselection, seed sweep or probability floor.
